matches.note: ICWF Cruiserweight Championship, a six-way Pyramid Match entered in two three-man groups; Syd Barrett pinned Kathryn Velvet Thomas to become the new champion.

ICWF Tag Team Championship, a Borneo Cage Match; the challenging Mob Squad (three men) won the titles from champions Brother & Brother, with a comic run-in from a costumed "Austin Powers" impersonator.
ICWF Intercontinental Championship; ruled a no contest after interference and a brawl drew the referee's stoppage. No title change.

notes: Four matches from ICWF's own sixth-anniversary card; a fifth, main-event World Championship match is previewed but its own broadcast does not survive in the held record. A flashback retrospective (part 1 of this repost) recaps earlier, already-dated shows and is not structured here.
